LESSON: READING 5.2.1 STUDY SKILLS- REFERENCE MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is the importance of reference materials?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects
   In simple words: practise until you can use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials.
4. Show that you can: use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Construct sentences using the given words,
2. Self- efficacy: It is enhanced as the learner gathers information from different reference materials.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the importance of reference materials?
2. How can one use reference materials appropriately?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
